algorithm.title: How Shipping Cost is Calculated
algorithm.intro: Our shipping calculator uses multiple factors to determine fair and accurate delivery costs for your customers.
algorithm.formula: Shipping Cost = Base + (Distance × Price/km) + (Weight × Price/kg) + (Volume × Price/m³) + (Time × Price/min)
algorithm.base_cost_desc: Fixed fee applied to every delivery regardless of distance or size.
algorithm.distance_cost_desc: Calculated using H3 geospatial zones. The system determines the shortest route distance from warehouse to customer location.
algorithm.weight_cost_desc: Based on total weight of all items in the order. Heavier orders cost more to deliver.
algorithm.volume_cost_desc: Based on the total volume (cubic meters) of all items. Bulky items take up more delivery space.
algorithm.time_cost_desc: Optional charge based on estimated delivery time. Useful for express delivery pricing.
algorithm.bounds_desc: The final calculated cost is bounded between minimum and maximum values. This ensures customers aren't charged too little (below cost) or too much (unfair pricing).
algorithm.discounts_desc: Customers can earn shipping discounts based on their order total. Higher order values unlock bigger discounts, up to 100% (free shipping). This encourages larger orders.
algorithm.example_desc: A customer 15km away ordering 5kg of products: Base (200) + Distance (15×30=450) + Weight (5×10=50) = 700 DZD. If their order total is 8,000 DZD and there's a 50% discount tier at 5,000 DZD, they pay 350 DZD.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AgroClik ("we", "us", or "our") operates the AgroClik mobile application (the "Service"). This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our Service and the choices you have associated with that data.
privacy.introduction_text: This Service is provided by AgroClik at no cost and is intended for use as is. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacy.collection_text: For a better experience, while using our Service, we may require you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information, specifically for business operations. The information that we request will be retained by us and used as described in this privacy policy. The app uses third-party services that may collect information used to identify you.
privacy.log_data_text: We want to inform you that whenever you use our Service, in a case of an error in the app, we collect data and information (through third-party products) on your phone called Log Data. This Log Data may include information such as your device Internet Protocol ("IP") address, device name, operating system version, the configuration of the app when utilizing our Service, the time and date of your use of the Service, and other statistics.
privacy.cookies_text: Cookies are files with a small amount of data that are commonly used as anonymous unique identifiers. This Service does not use these "cookies" explicitly. However, the app may use third-party code and libraries that use "cookies" to collect information and improve their services. You have the option to either accept or refuse these cookies.
privacy.service_providers_text: We may employ third-party companies and individuals due to the following reasons:

privacy.service_providers_note: We want to inform users of this Service that these third parties have access to your Personal Information. The reason is to perform the tasks assigned to them on our behalf. However, they are obligated not to disclose or use the information for any other purpose.
privacy.security_text: We value your trust in providing us your Personal Information, thus we are striving to use commercially acceptable means of protecting it. But remember that no method of transmission over the internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure and reliable, and we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
